dataset_name: Synthetic Vehicle Resistance Dataset for Gradient Descent
purpose: Fit F_res = c0 + c2*v^2 using gradient descent and compare with least squares.

columns.speed_mps: Synthetic vehicle speed in metres per second
columns.force_N: Synthetic noisy resistance force in newtons; primary training target
columns.noise_N: Synthetic noise added to the generating force; audit/debug only
columns.force_without_noise_N: Underlying synthetic force before noise; debug/visualization only, not primary training target

important_limitations: This dataset is synthetic and is not measured Formula 1 telemetry or real vehicle resistance data.
The force_N column is simulated from the stated equation plus noise.
Do not claim that fitted coefficients calibrate a real F1 car.
Use speed_mps and force_N for the primary fit; do not use force_without_noise_N as the training target unless explicitly running a separate noiseless demonstration.
